meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'she', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Никуда она с ним не поедет!
examples.trans: She is not going anywhere with him!

examples.text: Она у нас уже взрослый человек.
examples.trans: She is already a grown adult.

examples.text: Она вправе сама принимать важные решения.
examples.trans: She has the right to make important decisions herself.

meanings.en: strong, powerful (also used as a noun: the strong)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ильный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('strong').

examples.text: У неё сегодня сильный скачок давления.
examples.trans: She had a severe blood pressure spike today.

examples.text: Не думай про маму, она сильная.
examples.trans: Do not worry about mom, she is strong.

examples.text: Доктор, кто это вас так сильно?
examples.trans: Doctor, who hit you so hard like that?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronominal determiner meaning 'that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А я пойду закажу этот шкаф.
examples.trans: And I will go order that wardrobe.

examples.text: Этот француз — настоящий инспектор Мишлен!
examples.trans: This Frenchman is a real Michelin inspector!

examples.text: Подожди, этот француз правда инспектор?
examples.trans: Wait, is this Frenchman really an inspector?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'more', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: И что теперь, нужна больница?
examples.trans: And what now, does she need a hospital?

examples.text: Больная у нас резко выздоравливает.
examples.trans: Our patient is making a sudden recovery.

examples.text: Тем более я всегда буду рядом.
examples.trans: Especially since I will always be nearby.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'егда').

examples.text: Тем более я всегда буду рядом.
examples.trans: Especially since I will always be nearby.

examples.text: Как всегда, мы думали только о себе.
examples.trans: As always, we thought only about ourselves.

examples.text: Оставь своё предложение при себе навсегда!
examples.trans: Keep your offer to yourself forever!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'will be'.

examples.text: У меня есть машинка.
examples.trans: I have a toy car.

examples.text: Детство было трудное.
examples.trans: Childhood was hard.

examples.text: Ты будешь просить прощения.
examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'beside', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Тем более я всегда буду рядом.
examples.trans: Especially since I will always be nearby.

examples.text: А вот это уже вряд ли.
examples.trans: Now that is very unlikely.

examples.text: Место рядом с Григорием Сопрыкиным.
examples.trans: A plot next to Grigory Soprykin.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'really', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Лучше бы ты правда была беременна!
examples.trans: It would be better if you really were pregnant!

examples.text: Она вправе сама принимать важные решения.
examples.trans: She has the right to make important decisions herself.

examples.text: Ты правда так спокойно думаешь?
examples.trans: Do you really think so calmly?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'my', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А как же мы с мамой?
examples.trans: And what about your mother and me?

examples.text: Извините, вы мой бумажник не видели?
examples.trans: Excuse me, have you seen my wallet?

examples.text: Пойдём скорее отсюда, мой дорогой.
examples.trans: Let us go quickly from here, my dear.
